people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Dura
people.line: A plain in Babylon where Nebuchadnezzar set up a statue.

people.name: Nebuchadnezzar
people.line: Emperor of Babylon who conquered Judah

translations.web: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was sixty cubits, and its width six cubits. He set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.
translations.bsb: King Nebuchadnezzar made a golden statue sixty cubits high and six cubits wide, and he set it up on the plain of Dura in the province of Babylon.
translations.kjv: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.
